name: Xi Fan
description: Starting from the Wei, Jin, Southern and Northern Dynasties, brides used wedding fans to cover their faces with wedding fans to hide shame and ward off evil spirits, which is called the "queuing fan ceremony". The Pinku happy Fan uses a new semi-dimensional fan design, using the ultimate use of red and gold colors to depict the camellias and the clusters of flowers, allowing youth to bloom like flowers and bravely pursue the love of a lifetime; it creates a testimony of happy love, and the beautiful meaning is all in the fan.
